advisories.rule_name: PAGASA Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal Active

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

advisories.responsible_office: PAGASA + DA RFO 02 + LGU MDRRMC + MAO
adaptation_measures: Secure harvested produce, seed stocks, fertilizer, machinery, and livestock shelters before strong winds arrive.
Conduct early harvest for mature rice, corn, and HVCC where safe.
Prepare drainage outlets and post-event damage assessment forms with MAO and MDRRMC.

texts.bulletin: OFFICIAL PAGASA TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY - City of Tuguegarao, Cagayan: TCWS Signal No. 1 is active for the province due to Luis. Suspend field operations, secure machinery and harvested produce, avoid exposed coastal/upland areas, and coordinate with MDRRMC/MAO for pre-disaster agriculture actions.
texts.sms: PAGASA TCWS 1: Suspend farm work in City of Tuguegarao. Secure crops/equipment. Coordinate with MAO/MDRRMC.
texts.lgu:
PAGASA TCWS ADVISORY - City of Tuguegarao
Signal No. 1 is active for Cagayan.
Actions: suspend field operations, secure harvest and inputs, pre-position assessment teams, and prepare crop damage documentation.
texts.facebook:
PAGASA TCWS ALERT - City of Tuguegarao, Cagayan

Suspend farm operations and secure harvested crops, machinery, and livestock areas. Coordinate with your MAO and MDRRMC for assistance.

calendar_anchor.note: Current rice/corn stages are anchored to the municipal ACAP crop calendar.

adaptation_measures: Use mechanical dryers, covered drying floors, tarpaulins, and ventilated temporary storage.
Prioritize hauling of wet palay/corn to postharvest facilities to avoid quality losses.
Monitor grain moisture before storage and milling.

texts.bulletin: POSTHARVEST DRYING RISK - City of Tuguegarao: Drying class is unsuitable. Avoid open sun-drying if rain/high humidity persists. Prioritize mechanical dryers, tarpaulins, covered temporary storage, and rapid hauling to postharvest facilities.
texts.sms: DA WARNING: Drying risk in City of Tuguegarao. Use mechanical dryer/covered storage; avoid wet grain spoilage.
texts.lgu:
POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - City of Tuguegarao
Coordinate mobile dryers, tarpaulins, and storage support for farmers harvesting rice/corn.
texts.facebook: POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - City of Tuguegarao: High drying risk. Use mechanical dryers or covered storage to protect palay/mais quality.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Coordinate field validation with MAO/AEWs before public release.
Prioritize advisories for vulnerable rainfed and smallholder production areas.
Document farm impacts for DA and PCIC support where losses are observed.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER IRRIGATION - City of Tuguegarao: supplemental irrigation and pump operation should be deferred. Basis: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. ACAP calendar anchor: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling. Recommended action: pause irrigation to avoid over-saturation; prioritize drainage and canal checks first.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer irrigation in City of Tuguegarao. Recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER IRRIGATION - City of Tuguegarao
Operation: supplemental irrigation and pump operation
Why defer: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation.
ACAP calendar: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling.
LGU/MAO action: pause irrigation to avoid over-saturation; prioritize drainage and canal checks first; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Irrigation - City of Tuguegarao: Please defer supplemental irrigation and pump operation for now. Reason: recent rainfall is enough that irrigation can be paused to prevent over-saturation. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

advisories.rule_name: Operations Advisory - Defer Open-Air Grain Drying

calendar_anchor.note: Operation advisory is tied to the municipality's current ACAP rice/corn stage(s); the operation may be preparatory or postharvest relative to the active stage.

adaptation_measures: Coordinate field validation with MAO/AEWs before public release.
Prioritize advisories for vulnerable rainfed and smallholder production areas.
Document farm impacts for DA and PCIC support where losses are observed.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - City of Tuguegarao: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. ACAP calendar anchor: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer open-air grain drying in City of Tuguegarao. High humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - City of Tuguegarao
Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable.
ACAP calendar: Aug 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling.
LGU/MAO action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Open-Air Grain Drying - City of Tuguegarao: Please defer sun-drying of palay or corn grain for now. Reason: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 2 - Seedling; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Tasseling. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - City of Tuguegarao: 19 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.
texts.sms: DA WATCH: Wet/humid days in City of Tuguegarao. Scout crops for disease; spray only in clear, low-wind weather.
texts.lgu:
DISEASE WATCH - City of Tuguegarao
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - City of Tuguegarao: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER PESTICIDE / FOLIAR SPRAYING - City of Tuguegarao: pesticide, fungicide, herbicide, and foliar application should be deferred. adaptation_measures: Secure harvested produce, seed stocks, fertilizer, machinery, and livestock shelters before strong winds arrive.

texts.bulletin: OFFICIAL PAGASA TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY - Tuao, Cagayan: TCWS Signal No. 1 is active for the province due to Luis. Suspend field operations, secure machinery and harvested produce, avoid exposed coastal/upland areas, and coordinate with MDRRMC/MAO for pre-disaster agriculture actions.
texts.sms: PAGASA TCWS 1: Suspend farm work in Tuao. Secure crops/equipment. Coordinate with MAO/MDRRMC.
texts.lgu:
PAGASA TCWS ADVISORY - Tuao
Signal No. 1 is active for Cagayan.
Actions: suspend field operations, secure harvest and inputs, pre-position assessment teams, and prepare crop damage documentation.
texts.facebook:
PAGASA TCWS ALERT - Tuao, Cagayan

Suspend farm operations and secure harvested crops, machinery, and livestock areas. Coordinate with your MAO and MDRRMC for assistance.

calendar_anchor.note: Current rice/corn stages are anchored to the municipal ACAP crop calendar.

adaptation_measures: Use mechanical dryers, covered drying floors, tarpaulins, and ventilated temporary storage.
Prioritize hauling of wet palay/corn to postharvest facilities to avoid quality losses.
Monitor grain moisture before storage and milling.

texts.bulletin: POSTHARVEST DRYING RISK - Tuao: Drying class is high_risk. Avoid open sun-drying if rain/high humidity persists. Prioritize mechanical dryers, tarpaulins, covered temporary storage, and rapid hauling to postharvest facilities.
texts.sms: DA WARNING: Drying risk in Tuao. Use mechanical dryer/covered storage; avoid wet grain spoilage.

POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - Tuao
Coordinate mobile dryers, tarpaulins, and storage support for farmers harvesting rice/corn.
texts.facebook: POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - Tuao: High drying risk. Use mechanical dryers or covered storage to protect palay/mais quality.

adaptation_measures: Secure harvested produce, seed stocks, fertilizer, machinery, and livestock shelters before strong winds arrive.

adaptation_measures: Avoid strenuous field operations during peak heat hours.

texts.bulletin: HIGH HEAT STRESS — San Mateo: Avoid prolonged field work from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Ensure adequate hydration for farm workers. Monitor heat-sensitive crops (vegetables, high-value crops). Reschedule spraying and transplanting to early morning hours. Check livestock ventilation and water supply.

HEAT STRESS ADVISORY — San Mateo

adaptation_measures: Secure harvested produce, seed stocks, fertilizer, machinery, and livestock shelters before strong winds arrive.

Suspend field operations, secure machinery and harvested produce, avoid exposed coastal/upland areas, and coordinate with MDRRMC/MAO for pre-disaster agriculture actions.

Operation: manual harvest, combine harvest, hauling from field

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Dupax del Norte: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.

texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Dupax del Norte: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Defer pesticide or foliar spraying during rain, strong wind, or very high humidity.
Resume only during calm, dry windows and follow label safety intervals.
Strengthen pest scouting and non-chemical IPM while spraying is delayed.

texts.bulletin: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Dupax del Norte: Do not apply pesticides or foliar fertilizers in rainy conditions. Rain within 4–6 hours of application will wash off chemicals, reducing efficacy and increasing environmental contamination risk. Reschedule spraying to early morning hours on clear days.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not spray pesticides when raining. Reschedule to clear morning. Saves money, protects water.
texts.lgu: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Dupax del Norte: Rainfall expected. Advise farmers to defer all pesticide and foliar spraying.
